programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The rare earth
programme.desc: Along the way, Chip and his friends find an island surrounded by a large lake of acid, under the constant threat of eruption of a volcano. In the island lives lanthanide atoms, according to the legend, are awaiting the arrival of a &quot;chosen&quot; to give them acid that prevents them from leaving the island. Chip, thanks to his book, discovers that the volcano emitted a base when mixed with the acid may neutralize and make the dangerous lake in a nice extension of salt water.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The desert
programme.desc: Across a hot desert Chip and the atoms found themselves with a tungsten atom that gives them refuge under a pyramid-shaped building that, until recently, had an ingenious cooling system through which flowed a stream of ammonia in its basement. But now, Dr. No has diverted the flow of ammonia for his own benefit. Chip discovers the point where ammonia diverts and builds a dam that returns to its normal course.

programme.desc: Bluey and Mum are off to Chloe's party and Bingo isn't invited. But armed with a magic featherwand that makes things incredibly heavy, Bingo can now stop them leaving the house.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Squash
programme.desc: When dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo are in control of their every move, and Bingo proves that big siblings don't always beat little siblings.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Speedy Pea
programme.desc: Evil Pea steals Supertato's brand new Tato Car but doesn't realise that the Grape Kids are in the back seat. Supertato has to get the Grape Kids back to safety and save his car.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Laughter Badge
programme.desc: From sensible chuckles and nervous giggles to Duggee's infectious laughter, once everyone starts, it's so hard to stop. What were they laughing about again? Anyone remember?

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: The Silver Fox
programme.desc: The formidable swordswoman Silver Fox was a child when her father was senselessly wounded by his step brother, and her mother raped. It is payback time eighteen years later, as her father trains her up with kung fu to take revenge on his behalf.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: The Bride Napping
programme.desc: A rich girl Yue Ying, together with her maid Chun Lan, encounter a poor scholar Bian Ji at a fete. Chun Lan realizes Yue Ying is in love with him, but mixes his identity with a bandit due to an old servant's confusion, threatening the couple's union. After a series of complications, misunderstandings and mismatches, Chun Lan finally saves the day.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: In this action comedy, two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and accidentally become patriotic heroes. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: The Warlord
programme.desc: A bandit became a warlord in northern China by helping Russia fight against Japan. Due to his ignorance and silly behaviour, he is seen as a joke to everyone. The warlord is finally killed by the daughter of a troupe master whom he had killed for no reason, bringing a befitting end to a traitor.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Renowned martial arts clan heir Yuan Ying Fei hires four down-and-out martial artists to eliminate the local escort agency's young chief, Guan Yuan. Unexpectedly, the four befriend Guan instead. When Yuan's conspiracy leads to Guan's death, they unite to avenge him.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love?

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: After many years as a respected actor and action choreographer, the Shaw Studio finally gave the dependable and commendable Hsu Hsia a chance to direct his own movies. He didn't waste the opportunity, inviting three other kung-fu designers to help on this fight-filled thriller. Wang Yu, co-star of such classics as Dirty Ho and The Kid With A Tattoo, here takes center stage as a young rascal caught between an anti-Ching Confederation and violent, vengeful Ching troops.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: Man Of Iron
programme.desc: A fearless fighter, Chou Lian Huan has risen to power in Shanghai with his exceptional combat skills. He risks his life for hostess Shen Ju Fang and embarks on a series of fierce battles against the son of a notorious triad leader and his gang, ultimately becoming a scapegoat in the gang's deadly turf war.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased master's sword called the "Green Frost Sword". Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Qing government assigns fighters to destroy Shaolin Temple and kill all the disciples, but two of them successfully escaped. They train under different masters and learn the Wing Chun and Hung Quan styles respectively, finally killing the fighters and taking revenge for the death of their fellow disciples.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: This is adapted from Louis Cha's "The Book and the Sword". A young swordsman is tasked to lead a patriotic secret society to fight the traitorous general who colludes with the enemy. At the same time, he encounters a female warrior and two beautiful princesses, and is caught between all their affections for him.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become "The Five Shaolin Masters".

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her family's massacre years ago.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Call to Arms
programme.desc: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi. At the same time, he is assigned by a revolutionary group to steal the valuable "Sutra of 42 Chapters," which Emperor Kang Xi himself is also seeking. Demonstrating keen intelligence, Xiao Bao deftly navigates between opposing factions and successfully evades danger.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her...

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: Zombie Island
programme.desc: Jeff, a big fan of zombies, goes to a deserted and mysterious island with his friends hoping to seek out exciting adventures. What started as an adventure turns out to be a horrifying journey as they get trapped on the island and are attacked by the zombies! Their lives are in danger when they fail to fight back, and the game has only just begun!

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud's successor as the city's guard.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other's true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Directed by the acclaimed filmmaker Wong Kar Wai, this epic action feature begins in Foshan when Ip Man, the martial arts master from the south, takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called "Kung Fu Stuntmen". This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Hong Kong police officer Ah Shan goes undercover in prison to gain the trust of criminal Tian, in order to seek evidence against his gang. After their release from jail, Shan helps Tian rise within the gang and become the new boss. However, just as Shan successfully cracks down on the gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Fight Back to School II
programme.desc: Following his demotion, officer Sing resigns from the police force and goes undercover at an international school to privately investigate a terrorist plot. There, he discovers bumbling detective Tat posing as a teacher. Forced into an alliance, they team up to confront the heavily armed criminals behind the plot in a chaotic showdown.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident...

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.desc: From the Mehrangarh Fort in Jodhpur to the king’s palace in Nimaj, Sommer Shiels gets a taste of Rajasthan’s royal heritage.

programme.title: 10 Days South Africa - Kruger National Park
programme.desc: Alex Outhwaite has once-in-a-lifetime experiences at Kruger National Park, and sees a tribal music and dance performance in Johannesburg.

programme.title: Taco To Tikka - Mumbai
programme.desc: Charlie dives into Mumbai’s vibrant food scene, discovering timeless street favorites, cherished family recipes, and daring culinary innovations.

programme.title: Costa Rica Calling - Chilamate
programme.desc: In the heart of Costa Rica's countryside, Genevieve embarks on a journey of cultural immersion in Chilamate.

programme.title: World Heritage - The Ancient Cities of Sri Lanka
programme.desc: The central plains of Sri Lanka are dotted with crumbling temples, lost cities and ruins of sacred Buddhist sites are few of the sites now ranking as national treasures.

programme.title: Travel Diaries Of Healer and Rohan - Auli
programme.desc: Rohan introduces his spirited canine companion, Healer, to snow for the very first time at Auli, a popular hill station in Uttarakhand.

programme.title: Backpack Indonesia - Jakarta & JogJakarta ,Indonesia
programme.desc: Hannah Jackson visits the Borobudur temple and explores the local art and nightlife scenes in Jogjakarta.

programme.title: 10 Days Korea - Seoul
programme.desc: From markets and temples to a palace that was the headquarters of one of Medieval Asia’s biggest empires, Andrew explores the iconic sights of Seoul.

programme.title: The Food Guide - Manchester
programme.desc: Joe Remblance explores Manchester’s cosmopolitan culinary scene through dishes such as Black Pudding, Chicken Curry and Fried Chicken Waffle Pizza

programme.title: Costa Rica Calling - Rincón de la Vieja
programme.desc: Costa Rica is home to nearly 30 national parks, and Genevieve sets out to explore one of them, Rincón de la Vieja.

programme.title: City Breaks - Samarkand, Uzbekistan
programme.desc: Stories of king Timur’s reign and the Silk road lie in the mosaic-covered masterpieces of ancient Samarkand.

programme.title: The Moroccan Chronicles - Eternal Love in Chefchaouen
programme.desc: Rafe visits Chefchaouen and is instantly besotted with the city, much to the confusion of the locals who are baffled by his eccentricities.

programme.title: Backpack Indonesia - Mt. Bromo & Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Hannah Jackson visits the youngest volcano on the ancient Tengger caldera, Mount Bromo. She also goes to see the Komodo dragons.

programme.title: 10 Days Korea - Busan
programme.desc: Andrew Maciver dives headlong into deeply traditional South Korean experiences at Busan, the country’s favourite seaside escape.

programme.title: Food Stories Singapore - Chinese
programme.desc: Find out how the flavours of China have come to be such an integral part of the cuisine of Singapore.

programme.title: Costa Rica Calling - Guanacaste
programme.desc: Genevieve is drawn to Costa Rica's stunning Guanacaste region by its promise of thrilling water adventures.

programme.title: City Breaks - Bukhara, Uzbekistan
programme.desc: In the madrassahs and minarets of Bukhara, Alex Outhwaite finds parts of Central Asia that have remained nearly unchanged for centuries.

programme.title: The Moroccan Chronicles - The Ballad of Fes

programme.title: Backpack Indonesia - Labuan Bajo & Bali, Indonesia
programme.desc: Hannah Jackson explores the scenery, culture and flavours on the islands of Komodo National Park. She also visits the Taman Ayun temple in Bali.

programme.title: 10 Days Korea - Jeju Island
programme.desc: From a volcano rising out of the sea to a village of tough old female divers, Andrew Maciver explores everything that is unique about Jeju island.

programme.title: Food Stories Singapore - Indian
programme.desc: From fish head curry to ‘Rojak’, why do visitors from India in Singapore find it difficult to identify with the Indian dishes in the country?

programme.title: Costa Rica Calling - Puntarenas

programme.title: 72 Hours Unplugged - London

programme.title: The Moroccan Chronicles - One Flew Over Casablanca
programme.desc: At Casablanca, Rafe draws hilarious connections between what he sees, and the 1942 Hollywood classic named after the city.

programme.title: Food Stories Singapore - Malay
programme.desc: What does the cuisine of Singapore, which has almost entirely been shaped by immigrants, tell us about the culture of the land?

programme.title: Unwind - The PalaceDowntown, Dubai

programme.title: The Moroccan Chronicles - Uncharted Marrakech
programme.desc: The evocative city of Marrakech has long provided great artists with inspiration, but will it be able to give Rafe the adventure he seeks?

programme.title: The King Of Snooker - EP13
programme.desc: The all-conquering snooker player YAU YAT KIU (Cheng Siu Chau, Adam) takes everyone by surprise when he suddenly retires from the snooker world. This comes as a huge disappointed to her daughter YAU KA KAN (Niki Chow), who has always wanted to follow in his footsteps. She feels bewildered too, for although KIU pretends he does not care about the snooker any more, he has set up an extremely difficult game in his restaurant.

programme.title: Can't Buy Me Love - EP3
programme.desc: Reluctant to marry into the Tibetan royal family, the willful Princess CHIU YEUNG (Charmaine Sheh) has to find herself a husband as soon as possible. Owner of a gold store TING LOI-HEI (Kwan Kuk Ying) recommends her second and third sons, KAM DOR-LUK (Moses Chan) and KAM DOR-SHAU (Wong Ho Yin) to the Princess, hoping that the royal marriage would bring them out of financial crisis and save their family business somehow.

programme.title: Unchained Medley - EP8
programme.desc: Pop musician Ding Yat-chun (Owen Cheung) is often troubled by nightmares. He then gets embroiled in a plagiarism scandal, so he moves to a small village for the time being as he also wants to relax. Yat-chun unwittingly opens an old Cantonese opera costume trunk in the village house, releasing the ghost of opera diva Wan Lau-fong (Katy Kung). In the 1990s, Lau-fong was a Cantonese opera diva, but she passed away due to some accident. Lau-fong has forgotten almost everything about her human life.

programme.title: Rosy Business - EP19
programme.desc: HONG PO KEI’s (Tang Shui Man, Sheren) engagement with Wuxi rice baron TSEUNG KIU (Yueh Wah) broke off many years ago when a natural disaster hit the country. Later when the country was running out of food supply her whole family was killed and she become a criminal. Over the years, KEI has never got over KIU. She has been trying to prove he is not as heartless as the others think. Fate has it that they meet again and she becomes his fourth wife.

programme.title: Storm In A Cocoon - EP28
programme.desc: Wing Tai Lung is the silk kingdom in Canton during the early years of Republic China. Its owner POON WING-NIN (Yueh Hua), because of his advanced age, has handed over the charge to his elder son POON KA-HIN (Evergreen Mak) and daughter POON HAU-YEE (Hong Wah). Out of the blue, HAU-YEE commits suicide, so his second son POON KA-YEUNG (Steven Ma), who was serving as a combat medic, returns to his hometown, taking over the reins.

Owner of a gold store TING LOI-HEI (Kwan Kuk Ying) recommends her second and third sons, KAM DOR-LUK (Moses Chan) and KAM DOR-SHAU (Wong Ho Yin) to the Princess, hoping that the royal marriage would bring them out of financial crisis and save their family business somehow.

programme.title: Unchained Medley - EP10
programme.desc: Pop musician Ding Yat-chun (Owen Cheung) is often troubled by nightmares. He then gets embroiled in a plagiarism scandal, so he moves to a small village for the time being as he also wants to relax. Yat-chun unwittingly opens an old Cantonese opera costume trunk in the village house, releasing the ghost of opera diva Wan Lau-fong (Katy Kung). In the 1990s, Lau-fong was a Cantonese opera diva, but she passed away due to some accident. Lau-fong has forgotten almost everything about her human life.

programme.title: Rosy Business - EP21
programme.desc: HONG PO KEI’s (Tang Shui Man, Sheren) engagement with Wuxi rice baron TSEUNG KIU (Yueh Wah) broke off many years ago when a natural disaster hit the country. Later when the country was running out of food supply her whole family was killed and she become a criminal. Over the years, KEI has never got over KIU. She has been trying to prove he is not as heartless as the others think. Fate has it that they meet again and she becomes his fourth wife.

programme.title: Storm In A Cocoon - EP32
programme.desc: Wing Tai Lung is the silk kingdom in Canton during the early years of Republic China. Its owner POON WING-NIN (Yueh Hua), because of his advanced age, has handed over the charge to his elder son POON KA-HIN (Evergreen Mak) and daughter POON HAU-YEE (Hong Wah). Out of the blue, HAU-YEE commits suicide, so his second son POON KA-YEUNG (Steven Ma), who was serving as a combat medic, returns to his hometown, taking over the reins.

programme.title: Food Of Love - EP1
programme.desc: Gifted cooking talent Tak (Wong Hei) wants to be a successful chef. He does not give up even when his father Kin (Leung Ka Yan) is against the idea. His uncle Kwai (Lau Kar Fai) is on his side and finally Tak is given a chance to learn in a Chinese restaurant in a hotel. There he meets his dream girl Wing (Kennix Kwok) and wins her heart. Tak’s best friend Lam (Fennie Yuen) is upset when she learns about this.

programme.title: The King Of Snooker - EP15
programme.desc: The all-conquering snooker player YAU YAT KIU (Cheng Siu Chau, Adam) takes everyone by surprise when he suddenly retires from the snooker world. This comes as a huge disappointed to her daughter YAU KA KAN (Niki Chow), who has always wanted to follow in his footsteps. She feels bewildered too, for although KIU pretends he does not care about the snooker any more, he has set up an extremely difficult game in his restaurant.

programme.title: The Silver Chamber Of Sorrows - EP12
programme.desc: "Sheung’s Silver Chamber", the largest jewel company in Foshan, Guangdong Province China, is facing serious financial difficulties. In order to obtain a loan from SHUM’s family, SHEUNG HANG (Chun Pui), owner of the Chamber, together with his primary wife, CHOI SIU-DIP (Sit Ka Yin), plot to arrange marriage between SHEUNG WAN (Ng Wai Kwok), HANG’s younger brother, and SHUM WING-TUNG (Young Yuen Yee), daughter of SHUM’s family.

programme.title: Hong Kong Love Stories - EP7
programme.desc: Nice guy designer Chan Tsz-long (Joey Law) and his idealist girlfriend Yau Hoi-kei (Katy Kung) are a typical Hong Kong couple reluctantly living an unsettled life due to land issues. Tsz-long’s two younger sisters Chan Tsz-yan (Venus Wong) and Chan Tsz-ting (Kayan Yau) are polar opposites. Photographer Tsz-yan keeps indulging in artist Ki Ka-hei’s (Brian Tse) decadent paradise. Well-behaved and diligent college goddess Tsz-ting adopts a realistic approach when she finds her first love.

programme.title: The Ultimate Addiction - EP10
programme.desc: Financial elite, CHEUK YUK (Bosco Wong), never hesitates to use any dirty tricks to gain a profit, so he has been under close surveillance by the Commercial Crime Bureau (CCB). Being obsessed with money and power, CHEUK YUK constantly neglects his family members and friends. Because of him, his wife and mentor pass away respectively, yet he shows no remorse at all. On the contrary, his craving for money and power continuously increases.

programme.title: The Conquest - EP3
programme.desc: During the Spring and Autumn Period, ancient China was divided into small kingdoms ruled by various powerful regional warlords. This was a time of massive upheaval when a myriad of dramatic stories took place. The more than 20-year-long fight among the man of virtue FAN LAI (CHEN KUN), the persistent and dauntless AU TSIN (LAU CHUNG YAN, DAMIAN), the legendary hero FU CHAI (MA TAK CHUNG, JOE) and the mesmerizing beauty SAI SZE (KWOK, SONIJA) is a true classic that will long be remembered.

programme.title: 美丽人生壮志高飞第444集

programme.title: 美丽人生壮志高飞第445集
programme.desc: 台视60周年台庆大戏《美丽人生》第五单元《壮志高飞》，以1960年代高雄市旗津岛为故事起点，三位最美丽的台湾女人，在台湾最美丽的年代，在最美丽的旗津，悲欢交织而成的美丽人生。数百年前，旗津还没有一个统一的名称，岛的南端依旧与高雄相连。 而后，为了建造高雄港第二港口，旗津南端名唤『崩隙』的这片沙土挖空了，居民被迫迁移，旗津也因而断开 了与台湾的连系，犹如游子，离开了母亲的怀抱。土地会消失，历史也许会被淡忘，但曾经走过那段艰辛岁月的人们，他们的悲欢离合、笑容与泪水，仍将会转化为孕育后代子孙的养分，开出灿烂的花朵。这是属于我们上一代人的故事，也是我们这一代人的故事，是所有在这座岛屿上奋斗的人们的—《

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第21集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: 映照人生第495集
programme.desc: 印尼，是个超过两亿人口的东南亚大国，贫富差距极大，且语言文化种族差异均大。由印尼大爱台制作的「映照人生」，报导当地各面向的社会议题，从2010年起逐年获奖，被誉为是印尼正面纪录片的先驱之一。 制作团队都是由印尼的工作同仁，以在地观点，对印尼社会做深度观察，发现问题，报导当事人如何解决或面对，制作出一系列感人且启发人心的故事，传达以人道为关怀精神的节目内容。 本节目记录著印尼底层的人们，每个勇敢迎向苦难与希望的故事；也带领观众看见，这个世界的黑暗角落，因为人性的光辉，所映照出的光明。

programme.title: 法华经序HD中文版第1集
programme.desc: 法华经序系花莲静思精舍，于每日拂晓时分，僧俗二众的早课实录，意在启发自性本具的大乘精神；旨于引导大众常行菩萨道。除心无旁骛专注于当下课诵的经文外，同时扩及日常生活每一刻的专注、培养慈悲佛心，学习缩小自我，破我执，达到清澄的空慧般若。

programme.title: 无量义经偈颂第47集
programme.desc:
《无量义经》被誉为《法华经》的前导，也是大乘佛法中最能启发慈悲行的经典。对证严上人而言，这部经是毕生体悟最深的法门，更成为慈济法脉的根本依据。在 上人的带领下，《无量义经》成为慈济人行入人群的实践指南。
本节目以 上人讲解的《无量义经》偈颂为主轴，带领观众把经中智慧用在生活的每个当下，愿人人能从这部经中启发无量善念，为自己与社会带来更多和谐与光亮。

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第12集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

《无量义经》被誉为《法华经》的前导，也是大乘佛法中最能启发慈悲行的经典。对证严上人而言，这部经是毕生体悟最深的法门，更成为慈济法脉的根本依据。在 上人的带领下，《无量义经》成为慈济人行入人群的实践指南。
本节目以 上人讲解的《无量义经》偈颂为主轴，带领观众把经中智慧用在生活的每个当下，愿人人能从这部经中启发无量善念，为自己与社会带来更多和谐与光亮。

programme.title: 水返脚的春天第29集
programme.desc: 「水返脚」，就是现今「汐止」。当静芬见到山田，才知道他们在这山区住了二十年，却没见过对方。心宽念纯的静芬，人生的功课，包括：勇敢的拥抱养母说出爱；调柔一丝不苟固执的山田；小学毕业程度却能参加笔耕队，写作盲人与退伍老兵的感人文章登载于报纸，她的心路历程，见证了单纯能提升正面向上的力量。

programme.title: 风月同天-5分30秒版第36集
programme.desc: 「风月同天」此语出自八世纪日本长屋王赠予唐朝袈裟上的偈语：「山川异域，风月同天，寄诸佛子，共结来缘。」意指即使山川相隔，我们仍在同一片风与月之下，彼此牵系、共度风雨。影片以这份古老而永恒的慈悲为象征，映照出慈济志工在全球139个国家地区持续付出的身影—以行动，让爱无国界。这，就是慈济——一个由无数人的「小善」汇聚成世界之光的故事。

programme.title: TRY科学第1集
programme.desc: 你我的生活小问号，可能成就科学大发现。所以号召全民try科学，活化每个人潜在的科学基因。 生鸡蛋握掌心，为什么连壮汉都捏不破？！ 一片口香糖，要怎么打开没拉环的易开罐？ 科学基因不限男女老幼贫富贵贱，科学现象不分校园、街头、办公室或客厅，Try科学想戳醒你不找答案不行的好奇心。 Try科学以放大生活中各种有趣现象为诱因，以主持人科学机智问答的闯关设计，透过科学MAN吸引眼球的科学实验与找答案的逻辑推理……让科学接地气，让科学活用在生活里。

programme.title: 蔬果生活志第62集

programme.desc: 《MIT台湾志》是为台湾探访与见证前人留下历史足迹，为台湾这块土地留下一段完整纪录，并参照资料照片与麦觉明口头解说，令观众可以拼凑出当年历史。在每段广告之前，《MIT台湾志》会出现一则专题解说，是《MIT台湾志》另一项特色。《MIT台湾志》除富有历史文化探访纪录外，在探访路途上会不断探究与发现值得纪录之事，有：生态介绍、地质变化、新物种发现、辨认动植物、山岳特色与气候、术语解说、人文风情写实…等，这也见证了台湾前古后今、探史溯源的多元性纪录，是一部具有生态教学、文化品味、社会动态与价值变化的诠释，深深结合自台湾有开发历史以来，历经沧海桑田的岁月与战争留下的烙痕。

programme.desc: 本作品是以作者的童年（昭和49年，即1974年）生活为蓝本的故事，其中一事一物均充满著1970年代的怀旧气息。故事发生的舞台是日本静冈县清水市，那是一个不折不扣的美丽港都，是个交通便利、渔产丰富、又与富士山为邻的好地方。故事围绕著小丸子以及其家人和同学展开，有关于亲情、友谊等，或是一些生活小事，但当中有笑有泪，令人回想起童年的稚气。

programme.title: 唱歌给你听第53集
programme.desc: 故事讲述一个在台湾北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父亲不切实际地为这个家带来债务、困扰与纷争。时常失踪的父亲只能由任劳任怨的母亲咬牙把这个家支撑下去。多年后四处飘浪的父亲癌末回来找长大后的女儿，女儿为了处理父亲的临终把本已瓦解的家庭关系，再次找回分散各地家人，并在父亲临终前相互道歉、和解道别。

programme.title: 倚天屠龙记第23集
programme.desc: 元朝末年，屠龙宝刀再现江湖，武林各派你争我夺，激起一场腥风血雨！武当派张翠山与天鹰教殷素素因屠龙刀而相识、相恋，成亲生子，也因屠龙刀而丧命，留下孤儿张无忌。张无忌少年奇遇，修炼九阳神功有成！因祸得福，习乾坤大挪移脱险！拯救明教灭教之祸，被推举为教主！排解六大派纷争，誓死对抗蒙古人！。同时，蒙古郡主赵敏、峨嵋派周芷若、表妹殷离、波斯少女小昭对他的倾慕，让他不知所措，陷入情仇不分，爱中有恨的窘境………. lt;br/> lt;br/>主要演员lt;br/>曾舜晞 饰 张无忌lt;br/>陈钰琪 饰 赵 敏lt;br/>祝绪丹 饰 周芷若lt;br/>周海媚 饰 灭绝师太lt;br/>黑 子 饰 金毛狮王 谢 逊lt;br/>许雅

programme.desc: 身世神秘的青年范闲，历经家族、江湖、庙堂的种种考验与锤炼，他秉持正义、良善，开始了新的人生征途，从北齐假死归来归来，接掌内库却发现负债累累，决定靠自己的力量解决危机，在重重挑战下，他将面对庞大的势力与游戏规则，夺回自己的一切和想要的太平生活。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子第6季:第428集
programme.desc: 本作品是以作者的童年（昭和49年，即1974年）生活为蓝本的故事，其中一事一物均充满著1970年代的怀旧气息。故事发生的舞台是日本静冈县清水市，那是一个不折不扣的美丽港都，是个交通便利、渔产丰富、又与富士山为邻的好地方。故事围绕著小丸子以及其家人和同学展开，有关于亲情、友谊等，或是一些生活小事，但当中有笑有泪，令人回想起童年的稚气。

programme.title: 唱歌给你听第55集
programme.desc: 故事讲述一个在台湾北漂的家庭，浪漫天真的父亲不切实际地为这个家带来债务、困扰与纷争。时常失踪的父亲只能由任劳任怨的母亲咬牙把这个家支撑下去。多年后四处飘浪的父亲癌末回来找长大后的女儿，女儿为了处理父亲的临终把本已瓦解的家庭关系，再次找回分散各地家人，并在父亲临终前相互道歉、和解道别。

programme.title: 倚天屠龙记第24集
programme.desc: 元朝末年，屠龙宝刀再现江湖，武林各派你争我夺，激起一场腥风血雨！武当派张翠山与天鹰教殷素素因屠龙刀而相识、相恋，成亲生子，也因屠龙刀而丧命，留下孤儿张无忌。张无忌少年奇遇，修炼九阳神功有成！因祸得福，习乾坤大挪移脱险！拯救明教灭教之祸，被推举为教主！排解六大派纷争，誓死对抗蒙古人！。同时，蒙古郡主赵敏、峨嵋派周芷若、表妹殷离、波斯少女小昭对他的倾慕，让他不知所措，陷入情仇不分，爱中有恨的窘境………. lt;br/> lt;br/>主要演员lt;br/>曾舜晞 饰 张无忌lt;br/>陈钰琪 饰 赵 敏lt;br/>祝绪丹 饰 周芷若lt;br/>周海媚 饰 灭绝师太lt;br/>黑 子 饰 金毛狮王 谢 逊lt;br/>许雅

programme.title: 土地公传奇第36集

programme.title: 包青天第64集
programme.desc: 包拯为北宋仁宗天圣五年（1027年）申科进士甲科，初任建昌知县，官至开封府尹及龙图阁大学士，这跟电视上演的倒是相同。包拯是古代中国清官的典型代表，后世包括朱熹、欧阳修、司马光对他都有正面评价。宋仁宗年间，开封府尹包拯，通称「包青天」。为官清廉，为民伸冤，强调「人在做天在看」、「举头三尺有神明」不畏强权，除恶务尽。较脍炙人口的单元有「秦香莲」、「真假状元」、「貍猫换太子」等。

programme.desc: 公视手语新闻将转型！扩大对听障者的服务，将原「公视手语新闻」改版转型为更具资讯性与生活化的新闻节目「手语资讯站」，用轻松方式「看见」生活新闻资讯。另将推出专为听障朋友量身打造的单元「手语新闻通」，结合新闻小辞典以及每日一手语的特性，透过手语主播以及新闻画面或字幕说明，正确解释近日新闻焦点，让听障朋友清楚新闻脉络，也让观众学正确的手语。

programme.title: 公视越南语新闻第57集
programme.desc: 《公视越南语新闻》是一个针对越南语观众的新闻节目，提供最新、全面的国内外新闻报导，涵盖政治、经济、社会、文化等多方面的重要议题，让观众在母语中深入了解世界各地的时事动态。

programme.title: 公视印尼语新闻第57集
programme.desc: 《公视印尼语新闻》是一个专注于印尼语观众的新闻节目，提供最新的印尼本土与国际新闻报导，让观众获得全球时事、文化和政治等多方面的深入了解与连结。

programme.title: 公视泰语新闻第57集
programme.desc: 《公视泰语新闻》是一个为泰语观众制作的新闻节目，提供最即时和全面的国内外新闻报导，让观众深入了解泰国和世界各地的时事、政治、经济、文化等重要议题。

programme.title: 我爱亲家第1集
programme.desc: 《我爱亲家》是一部温馨逗趣的家庭喜剧，剧情描述两位原本各自要帮儿女相亲的单身父母，却在要帮儿女送作堆的过程中，渐渐爱上对方，双双因而陷入挣扎。除逗趣情节外，也探讨两代之间对婚姻的认同问题。在这「恐婚族」剧增的年代，提供一个有趣的切入角度，审视婚姻的价值与意义。

programme.title: 入世第1集
programme.desc: 阿公过世了，印尼籍看护莎莉看著没有人回来奔丧的情况下，莎莉变成为丧礼的亲族。

programme.title: 英伦自然四季纪事第2集
programme.desc: 真实描述了英国的自然风光和野生动物随著光阴流转产生的变化。

programme.title: 公视午间新闻第86集
programme.desc: 即时新闻，让听众得知最易于亲近的国内外大事。

programme.title: PeoPo公民新闻报第52集
programme.desc: 「PeoPo公民新闻报」报导在台湾甚至世界各地公民观点的新闻，不论您以文字、照片甚至影音方式来报导，PeoPo公民新闻报的主持人将会访问您对这则新闻的看法，以全新的观点来展现公民记者的行动力。

programme.title: 浩克慢游第77集
programme.desc: 「浩克慢游」，主题设定为「英雄的旅程」，制作人林彦辉分享，灵感来自旅行途中，遇见的那些坚守信念的人们，希望透过本季节目学习他们的勇敢，并感谢他们的付出，旅行是一种自我疗愈的过程。

programme.title: 我的婆婆怎么那么可爱2第15集
programme.desc: 时间来到2012年，这时的台南知名凤梨酥店老板娘苏林彩香已拥有财富自由、身体堪用、爱情稳定，不再受孩子们感情勒赎。

programme.title: 牛车来去第23集
programme.desc: 在1940 年代的台湾乡村，一桩足以牵动命运的交易让佃农与地主家族的人生永远改变，两家就此交织纠结。

programme.title: 行走TIT第292集
programme.desc: 台湾不只有十四族，八百部落各有特色。公视推出原乡部落行脚节目《行走TIT》，用脚、用眼、用心行走，带观众认识新台湾！首季探索十三个部落，挖掘罕为人知的部落故事。

programme.title: 妙妙犬布丽第3季:第24集

programme.desc: 开箱牧场小主人日常的一天，从儿童视角探索台湾牧场特色、学习动物科普知识，看见在牧场长大的孩子，展现对自然与动物的喜爱，也热情分享饲养心得。

programme.title: 水果冰淇淋第2764集
programme.desc: 单元多，可创造明快的节目节奏！不同的单元，犹如一个个不一样的抽屉，彼此的区隔明确清楚。 多样的单元，各有各的教育目标及观赏乐趣。不一样的孩子可以找到自己喜欢和认同的单元。幼儿的学习并非逻辑式的。单元式的学习方式，更能符合幼儿的学习与发展。综合杂志型态的节目类型，可以针对幼儿做全方位的生活学习。

programme.title: 台湾食堂第12集
programme.desc: 多元融合，煎煮炒炸，酸甜苦辣滋味丰富，是台菜特色。台菜也因体系庞杂，看得到外来「血缘」，以致若认真询问哪些菜才算正宗台菜，相信没有几个人能说的明白。台湾究竟有哪些值得推上国际的美食？什么是最能代表台湾的「台菜」？

programme.title: 在地旅行第12集
programme.desc: 走进在地，感受地方的温暖力量，用心体会这片土地的美好与感动，这不只是旅行，更是一场贴近土地的深刻体验，倾听故事，感受脉动中的生命力。 在地旅行将会一同与各位观众走进巷弄、踏入田野、深入原乡，倾听它的故事，观察它的脉动，寻找生命力，看见希望与未来！

programme.title: 公视晚间新闻第86集

programme.title: 同床第1集

programme.title: 大自然生趣第6集
programme.desc: 你知道台湾原生的鹿科动物总共有几种吗？你知道留鸟与夏候鸟的差别吗？你知道「南路鹰一万死九千」这句话的由来吗？你知道有哪些鸟是父亲负责孵蛋跟照顾小孩呢？ 请共下来了解，《大自然生趣》。 《大自然生趣》，照字面意思来说，是自然界中生生不息的各种生物所带来的许多趣味。很凑巧的，「生趣」这两个字，其实这是客语「有趣」的发音，因此换成客语来说，就是「大自然真有趣」。这个节目是将客籍生态纪录片导演刘燕明先生三十余年来上山下海，辛苦拍摄所得的丰富生态影像，以每集5分钟之短篇制作成有趣又具生态教育意义的短片，具有两大特色：1.生态专业团队制作：导演刘燕明先生与撰稿、旁白的邓庆煜先生，两人皆具备生态与纪录片拍

programme.title: 急流不归处第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 在爱达荷弗兰克丘奇荒野区住有一群男男女女，而素有「不归之河」之称的沙蒙河可说是荒野区的命脉。荒野区的生活天天都充满挑战，而在万物开始苏醒的春季，各种麻烦也随之而来。负责管理荒野区南支牧场的在地狩猎专家魏斯及其伴侣克丝汀娜这回遇上一个大麻烦，也就是横行牧场外围的一只成年公熊，魏斯将展开本季首次狩猎行动，以防止大熊破坏牧场果园。上集有惊无险地将旧曳引机运到镇上后，本集中，１１年资历的喷射快艇船长巴克杜伊要载著吉普车往沙蒙河上游航行，前往麦凯牧场，但途中引擎故障灯号再度亮起，这趟航程恐怕又要充满波折。印第安溪牧场管理员奥布莉这回在男友彼特的协助下，将首次挑战十分危险的伐木及锯木作业。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第14季:第11集
programme.desc: 德鲁和堤伊本集造访其他古董商进行采购。首先在雕像公园买下稀有的大型木制庭院椅，接著在一片马桶中发现秋千船和极为罕见的教堂停柩门，令德鲁喜出望外；秋千船经铁匠奈夫巧手改造后，变成能独立站立的特色摆饰。接著造访专攻世纪中期风格的拾荒兄弟，买下了大量摆饰和特独特的俄罗斯防爆灯，对这家店留下深刻印象。最后德鲁拜访古董商好友新店，对出色展品赞叹不已，更买下一座与他风格完全不搭、但十分美丽的特别书柜。在拾荒兄弟买回的物件很快就几乎销售一空。

programme.title: 旧货猎人修复篇第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 德鲁照旧拿来一个破烂不堪的皮包，打算请皮革大师马汀修复，马汀一眼就认出这是个格莱斯顿包，而且上面还有俄国王子的名字，原来此包来历不凡，这是沙皇亚历山大二世的私生子尤里夫斯基王子用过的包。雕刻家尼克这次合作的对象是另一个旧货商夏绿蒂，夏绿蒂带来一个古董石膏像，经过调查这个马头石膏像也是身世显赫，原作者是古希腊最伟大的雕刻家里西波斯，尼克为了向偶像致敬，使出浑身解数要修复这个石膏像。

programme.title: 蛮野一家特别篇第6季:第1集
programme.desc: 在这一集的蛮野一家，布朗一家动荡的一年导致他们山区家园的混乱。除了要面对土狼跟林鼠的入侵，还要做好准备面对零下的气温跟保护牲畜。在大家同心协力打造北极星牧场的主屋时，却遭受意外的灾难，要如何一边保持乐观努力不懈，一边面对意想不到的天灾。

programme.title: 金矿的赌注-救星佛莱迪第2季:第9集
programme.desc: 疏远了数十年的两兄弟，近年因为都对采金充满热情而再次团圆。

programme.title: 翻新中古车第18季:第1集
programme.desc: 本集节目中，麦克和艾维斯入手了一辆凯旋多罗米提Sprint。两人一开始对这辆车很犹豫，因为它的车身很脏，车子颜色不一致，原本的乙烯基车顶也没有了。但麦克在试开之后，发现车子的性能很好，因此决定把车子带回修车厂。究竟两人能否让这辆车再次容光焕发，并凸显出来原有的特质呢？

programme.desc: 在爱达荷弗兰克丘奇荒野区住有一群男男女女，而素有「不归之河」之称的沙蒙河可说是荒野区的命脉。荒野区的生活天天都充满挑战，而在万物开始苏醒的春季，各种麻烦也随之而来。负责管理荒野区南支牧场的在地狩猎专家魏斯及其伴侣克丝汀娜这回遇上一个大麻烦，也就是横行牧场外围的一只成年公熊，魏斯将展开本季首次狩猎行动，以防止大熊破坏牧场果园。上集有惊无险地将旧曳引机运到镇上后，本集中，１１年资历的喷射快艇船长巴克杜伊要载著吉普车往沙蒙河上游航行，前往麦凯牧场，但途中引擎故障灯号再度亮起，这趟航程恐怕又要充满波折。印第安溪牧场管理员奥布莉这回在男友彼特的协助下，将首次挑战十分危险的伐木及锯木作业。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第14季:第11集
programme.desc: 德鲁和堤伊本集造访其他古董商进行采购。首先在雕像公园买下稀有的大型木制庭院椅，接著在一片马桶中发现秋千船和极为罕见的教堂停柩门，令德鲁喜出望外；秋千船经铁匠奈夫巧手改造后，变成能独立站立的特色摆饰。接著造访专攻世纪中期风格的拾荒兄弟，买下了大量摆饰和特独特的俄罗斯防爆灯，对这家店留下深刻印象。最后德鲁拜访古董商好友新店，对出色展品赞叹不已，更买下一座与他风格完全不搭、但十分美丽的特别书柜。在拾荒兄弟买回的物件很快就几乎销售一空。

programme.title: 麦克布鲁尔-天生车商第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 麦克和蜜雪儿参加汽车拍卖会，但实际看到车子后，发现他可能买到了一辆烂车。

programme.title: 蛮野一家特别篇第6季:第2集
programme.desc: 本集蛮野一家特别篇将带大家回顾比利布朗传奇的一生，透过从未曝光的访谈片段以及家人访谈，从不同面向重新建构这位野地真汉子的人生。

programme.title: 金矿的赌注-救星佛莱迪第2季:第9集
programme.desc: 疏远了数十年的两兄弟，近年因为都对采金充满热情而再次团圆。

programme.title: 旧货猎人修复篇第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 德鲁照旧拿来一个破烂不堪的皮包，打算请皮革大师马汀修复，马汀一眼就认出这是个格莱斯顿包，而且上面还有俄国王子的名字，原来此包来历不凡，这是沙皇亚历山大二世的私生子尤里夫斯基王子用过的包。雕刻家尼克这次合作的对象是另一个旧货商夏绿蒂，夏绿蒂带来一个古董石膏像，经过调查这个马头石膏像也是身世显赫，原作者是古希腊最伟大的雕刻家里西波斯，尼克为了向偶像致敬，使出浑身解数要修复这个石膏像。

programme.title: 建筑巨擘-世界明珠
programme.desc: 一起见识工程的极限！在全球建筑条件最严峻的地区之一打造耐震、耐风数一数二的住宅建筑。

programme.title: 蛮野一家特别篇第6季:第2集
programme.desc: 本集蛮野一家特别篇将带大家回顾比利布朗传奇的一生，透过从未曝光的访谈片段以及家人访谈，从不同面向重新建构这位野地真汉子的人生。

programme.title: 美洲大地第1季:第9集
programme.desc: 带领观众探索美洲这片地球最大的陆地：唯一横跨南北两极的广阔大陆。透过鲜为人知的非凡野生动物故事，揭开壮丽景观背后的秘密与脆弱，牵动全世界的心

programme.title: 美洲大地第1季:第10集
programme.desc: 带领观众探索美洲这片地球最大的陆地：唯一横跨南北两极的广阔大陆。透过鲜为人知的非凡野生动物故事，揭开壮丽景观背后的秘密与脆弱，牵动全世界的心

programme.title: 急流不归处第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 爱达荷内陆素有「不归之河」之称的沙蒙河河水持续高涨，水位已达历史新高，在这块河区谋生的男男女女，又要迎接新挑战。荒野向导兼养马人朗恩安斯为了修整偏远小屋的屋顶，必须用马运载建材，但在那之前，朗恩得先把寄放在镇内牧场的六匹马带回家。菜鸟牧场管理员奥布莉巴顿面临危机，牧场里重要的谷仓到处都在漏水，奥布莉得想办法整修屋顶，但光是运送建材到牧场就有难度，奥布莉再度找来荒野区邻居帮忙，这次甚至动用了空中救兵。南支牧场管理员魏斯葛格瑞和克丝汀娜卡斯特奈利正在打造荒野区最大温室，然而作业到一半时，整座牧场突然断电，克丝汀娜一年半以来在温室所投注的时间和金钱恐怕会化为乌有……

programme.title: 金矿的赌注-救星佛莱迪第2季:第11集
programme.desc: 蒙大拿州的新救援任务才刚要展开，佛莱迪就因为身体不适，必须回到老家休养。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第14季:第12集
programme.desc: 本集德鲁前往约克夏进行采购之旅。首先在传统刀具店喜出望外地发现极佳刀匠凳；接著前往德鲁的古董商友人新店参观，德鲁努力杀价，最终满意买回几件美丽艺品。在前两处的战利品快速卖出后，德鲁重返约克夏，造访米德尔顿铁路，收购了几件旧货和一批意外罕见的灯具；最后来到古老剪刀工厂，在欣赏古老工艺之余，德鲁买下一组其所未见的的剪刀模具。隐藏各式宝藏的约克夏令德鲁十分满意，矢言将再次造访。

programme.title: 收藏改造家第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 跟著收藏达人一起发掘家中奇特收藏品的真正价值，再与设计师鲍比柏克Bobby Berk一起，决定是否卖出珍藏，换取迫切所需的住家翻修费用。

programme.title: 爸爸盖给你第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 泰勒帮丧偶的布兰登及他的三个小孩在布兰登姐姐家后院盖一个滑板坡道，配有A型结构以及阁楼。

programme.title: 家在阿拉斯加第9季:第1集
programme.desc: 在新一季的节目中，观众将看到奇尔曲家族如何对抗正在快速变化的阿拉斯加荒野，特别是主宰农场命运的天气，变得比以往更加阴晴不定，而农垦人家唯一能做的就是设法适应。今年,，这家人必须采用全新的策略，并发挥家族巧思，在追求进步之际，也坚守著老传统；同时家族的下一代必须史无前例地挺身接下承担。冬季大雨和快速融雪造成土地泥泞，使奥图必须修好一台老旧的挖土机，才能为牛只垦地。亚兹李和老亚兹则前往远方的佩尔岛，评估开发新牧地的可能性。艾文和奥古斯特兄弟打算设计一个新方式，改善家族每年为了跋涉狐河而遭遇的危险。

programme.title: 家在阿拉斯加第9季:第2集
programme.desc: 为了抵抗阿拉斯加严苛天候的摧残，农垦人家奇尔曲家族必须对抗不断变化的环境，持续建设新房屋和修理旧房舍，而这是一场没完没了的奋战。在本集中，奥图和夏绿蒂用上一个冒险的方法，要拯救他们最宝贵的驳船；为了避免雨水持续渗入船身，奥图决定以直升机空吊一座温室大棚架到船身甲板上；但此举非常危险，因为大棚架的重量很重，加上附近有高压电线，让所有人都心惊胆跳。珍恩和亚兹李要为爱犬威洛打造一个独特的新狗拉雪橇，加强牠的拖橇训练，希望能载运更多装备出入偏乡。艾文和伊芙家中的菜窖失去保冷功能，因此他们必须挑战一个巨大的新工程，保护他们的宝贵存粮。

programme.title: 头号通缉-少年骇客第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 基维马基展开一连串恶意报假案行动，骚扰一名联调局干员的家人。

programme.title: 单挑求生高手第3季:第3集
programme.desc: 本集艾德再次对抗暱称为「骆驼」的马克斯，这次的地形极为严峻，气候高温且干燥。

programme.title: 蛮野一家特别篇第6季:第3集
programme.desc: 本集透过遗失的影片，呈现比利与艾蜜的孩子们，如何透过自幼的耳濡目染，以及父母的谆谆教诲，学会在蛮荒之地讨生活。狼群以惊奇的创意就地取材，心灵手巧地满足各种生活所需，从对付残暴野兽和严峻气候，到维持个人卫生、美容保养，甚至还有娱乐以及盛大庆典。

programme.desc: 爱达荷内陆素有「不归之河」之称的沙蒙河河水持续高涨，水位已达历史新高，在这块河区谋生的男男女女，又要迎接新挑战。荒野向导兼养马人朗恩安斯为了修整偏远小屋的屋顶，必须用马运载建材，但在那之前，朗恩得先把寄放在镇内牧场的六匹马带回家。菜鸟牧场管理员奥布莉巴顿面临危机，牧场里重要的谷仓到处都在漏水，奥布莉得想办法整修屋顶，但光是运送建材到牧场就有难度，奥布莉再度找来荒野区邻居帮忙，这次甚至动用了空中救兵。南支牧场管理员魏斯葛格瑞和克丝汀娜卡斯特奈利正在打造荒野区最大温室，然而作业到一半时，整座牧场突然断电，克丝汀娜一年半以来在温室所投注的时间和金钱恐怕会化为乌有……

programme.title: 蛮野一家特别篇第6季:第3集
programme.desc: 本集透过遗失的影片，呈现比利与艾蜜的孩子们，如何透过自幼的耳濡目染，以及父母的谆谆教诲，学会在蛮荒之地讨生活。狼群以惊奇的创意就地取材，心灵手巧地满足各种生活所需，从对付残暴野兽和严峻气候，到维持个人卫生、美容保养，甚至还有娱乐以及盛大庆典。

programme.title: 旧货猎人第14季:第12集
programme.desc: 本集德鲁前往约克夏进行采购之旅。首先在传统刀具店喜出望外地发现极佳刀匠凳；接著前往德鲁的古董商友人新店参观，德鲁努力杀价，最终满意买回几件美丽艺品。在前两处的战利品快速卖出后，德鲁重返约克夏，造访米德尔顿铁路，收购了几件旧货和一批意外罕见的灯具；最后来到古老剪刀工厂，在欣赏古老工艺之余，德鲁买下一组其所未见的的剪刀模具。隐藏各式宝藏的约克夏令德鲁十分满意，矢言将再次造访。

programme.title: 西班牙边境护卫队第8季:第1集
programme.desc: 跟随西班牙边境巡逻局与海关执法局的官员们，看看他们如何打击偷渡者、军火走私犯与嚣张的毒枭集团

programme.title: 西班牙边境护卫队第8季:第2集

programme.title: 仓储挖宝王第3季:第11集
programme.desc: 维州阿林顿跟美国首府华盛顿住了许多政府与军事机关人员，这里的仓库里，有从战时纪念品到古董战役收藏品等物品，正是汤和艾伦喜欢的东西。

programme.title: 仓储挖宝王第3季:第12集
programme.desc: 帕沙第纳的仓库拍卖竞争相当激烈。艾伦和汤这天要参加一场盛大的货柜拍卖会，由于货柜的内容物都为了长途运送而紧密包装，要找到值钱品会很困难。

programme.title: 急流不归处第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 爱达荷弗兰克丘奇荒野区的春季即将结束，居民趁著这个充满希望的季节，向新一代传授技能。准丛林飞行员凯蒂在父亲麦克的带领下，将挑战首度在地形复杂的南支牧场降落。叱咤不归之河的喷射快艇船长巴克，这回带著儿子戴克斯熟悉这条无情河路，但年仅８岁的戴克斯力气还不够，开起这艘重达４千多公斤的船十分费力。印第安溪牧场新手管理员奥布莉原本打算整修谷仓屋顶，但母马靴靴随时都会临盆，因此奥布莉放下手边的工作，将靴靴摆在第一顺位。经验老道的荒野向导朗恩打算前往泰本小屋整修屋顶，他找了南支牧场管理员魏斯来帮忙，这两个业余屋顶工能否顺利完成屋顶整修工程呢？

programme.title: 西班牙海港护卫队第1季:第10集

programme.title: 旧货猎人第14季:第13集
programme.desc: 德鲁店内的商品迅速售出，于是他与堤伊再度上路，寻找有价值的奇珍异宝。这一周，他们到了三个不同的地方：一家位于沃灵顿的家族古董商店、巴克斯顿搬家清仓中的退休交易商，以及雪菲耳古董中心。如此的四处奔波，是否能让他们找到适合放在店内贩售的新商品呢？

programme.title: 旧货猎人第15季:第9集
programme.desc: 本集节目中，德鲁与提伊造访全国多处古董店。在一间石器专卖店买到了一个绝美的日晷，还有雕刻精致的海克力斯雕像。在东安格里亚的修复商店中看到许多好品味的家具，老板的修复功力也是一流。在杜德利一连逛了三间比邻而居的古董店，买到许多超值好物。

programme.title: 单挑求生高手第3季:第5集

programme.title: 原始生活21天第11季:第11集

programme.title: 翻新中古车第18季:第1集
programme.desc: 本集节目中，麦克和艾维斯入手了一辆凯旋多罗米提Sprint。两人一开始对这辆车很犹豫，因为它的车身很脏，车子颜色不一致，原本的乙烯基车顶也没有了。但麦克在试开之后，发现车子的性能很好，因此决定把车子带回修车厂。究竟两人能否让这辆车再次容光焕发，并凸显出来原有的特质呢？

programme.title: 战痘医师第4季:第4集

programme.title: 食材探源第1季:第10集
programme.desc: 主持人这一集要深入探讨如何在美国种植松露，她到北卡罗来纳州吉布森维尔拜访了扶植新手松露农的南西和松露研究员奥蒙格博士，了解松露嫁接与生长的方式，最后也以松露为主角，做出一套主厨套餐。

programme.title: 我的梦幻婚纱第19季:第7集
programme.desc: 聚焦形形色色的新娘，跟著她们位于曼哈顿的世界顶级克莱菲尔婚纱店寻找完美婚纱。直击婚纱店的幕后运作，在里头忙里忙外的工作人员，看看这些五味杂陈的准新娘如何挑选心中的梦幻婚纱。

programme.title: 我的梦幻婚纱第16季:第9集
programme.desc: 新娘艾曼内拉仗著爸爸的宠爱，不顾预算选购华丽蓬裙婚纱，爸爸听到超出预算两倍的价格吓到要崩溃；新娘玛琳娜希望挑一件能展现出对未婚夫与女儿之爱的婚纱，后来妈妈替她找到一件美丽的婚纱，但却超出预算。她愿意为了这件心爱的婚纱多花点钱吗？

programme.title: 整脊最上手第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 亚莉珊卓医师透过脊骨矫治的方式，帮助先天结缔组织异常病人雅莉、曾接受骨髓移植的麦特，还有因关节弯曲症在日常生活中过度使用颈部筋肉的莱恩。

programme.title: 大厨荷西全家游西班牙第1季:第4集

programme.desc: 跟随建筑师迪恩波顿Dean Poulton与设计师博贾马夸Borja de Maqua，看他们亲手修复一座曾属于亨利七世国王、历经三百年岁月洗礼的英式庄园。这座曾经宏伟却日渐破败的皇家遗迹，在两人的巧思与工艺下，从中世纪风格重生，蜕变成梦幻庄园。

programme.title: 好屋重生记第5季:第8集
programme.desc: 吉姆和夏塔经营一家非营利性艺廊，提供当地艺术家一个展示自己作品的地方，他们也会把房子以较低的价格租给本地的艺术家。这次他们找米娜和凯伦帮忙，改造位于内尔森的一间小屋，但毕竟是非营利性机构，所以他们的预算很有限。这对母女首先得改善屋内的格局，恢复原本有的门廊，确认拆除的墙是否有承重作用等等，设法打造出一间最适合艺术家居住的房子，让好屋彻底重生。

programme.title: 到国外征婚去第1季:第13集
programme.desc: 帕弗想把握时间多跟蜜雪儿相处，并主动提出要载她去机场，两人一路上相谈甚欢。哈洛德最后还是把戒指送给米凯拉，只不过不是作为求婚戒指，而是感情信物。

programme.title: 离开美国结婚去第7季:第2集
programme.desc: 对那些以爱之名移居海外的美国人，搬离美国的生活舒适圈值得吗？还是他们会捧著心碎搬回美国？

programme.title: 管教恶猫第7季:第3集
programme.desc: 这次杰克森碰到会攻击自己尾巴的史凯勒跟会随地大便又爱捣蛋的昆西。

programme.title: 生命不受限第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 在高山或大海深处，或是山海间的某处，每个生态区位都需要适应，几公尺的距离，就有生或死的差别。

programme.title: 鳄鱼拍档这一家第2季:第10集
programme.desc: 海洋中有七种海龟，牠们对海洋环境极为重要，因为牠们就像矿坑的金丝雀，是海洋生态健康的重要指标。这次澳洲动物园要野放三只海龟，其中的海龟基安娜，在被送到野生动医院时情况很危极，牠当时既瘦弱又有大量寄生虫。更糟的是，牠身体的一侧有一大块缺口，也许是鲨鱼或撞船造成的。野放团队决定将牠们空运到大堡礁最南端的艾略特夫人岛野放，因为那里是一个海洋保护区，能保护各种海洋生物，海龟也能在那里更安全地重新适应野外环境。但他们在空运途中必须注意飞行高度，因为海龟在高空会出现并发症。

programme.title: 爬虫侦探第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 缅甸干燥的蒲甘平原是爬虫学家纳森尼尔这次旅程的起点。这座平原上有三千多座寺庙，纳森尼尔在这里抓到了俗称「飞蛇」的美丽金花蛇，还有俗称「软壳龟」的缅甸箱鳖。接著他到博彬区，找到了世界第二大的蜥蜴：泽巨蜥。最后他在竹林里遇到世界上最毒的蛇类，眼镜王蛇，为百科全书资料收集之旅画上完美的句点。

programme.title: 热血兽医师第4季:第11集
programme.desc: 哈维飓风重创休斯顿，杰夫医生找佩特拉医生和救援人员乔治亚南下相助，在现场先进行基本医疗，包括注射疫苗；投药除虫、除蚤及除壁虱，他们带欧索、汤米、布朗妮、钱得乐等幼犬回丹佛，结扎后送养。其中钱得乐出现分离焦虑，乔治亚希望借助药物让牠冷静下来。小熊是十个月大的幼犬，因为乱吃袜子而呕吐，尼可斯医生为牠动手术取出异物。奇夫是12岁的老犬，有脾脏肿块和膀胱结石需要处理。麦克斯是养在室外的猫，因为背部受伤来求诊。

programme.title: 管教恶猫第7季:第3集
programme.desc: 这次杰克森碰到会攻击自己尾巴的史凯勒跟会随地大便又爱捣蛋的昆西。

programme.title: 动物父母心第1季:第4集
programme.desc: 生命离不开水，但是水太多或太少都可能带来灾难，也为养育后代的动物爸妈带来挑战。

programme.title: 灭绝动物大追踪第2季:第7集
programme.desc: 本集节目中，野生生物学家佛瑞斯特葛兰特来到越南寻找中南大羚，他带著队友深入安南山脉的山区，却发现盗猎者的陷阱。

programme.title: 鳄鱼拍档这一家第2季:第11集
programme.desc: 罗伯特长期带科摩多龙英妲进行目标训练，两位蜥蜴科学家前来研究英妲，利用高速摄影机和测力板了解古巨蜥，人类可能是牠们灭亡的原因，答案在于速度。小南是孤儿无尾熊宝宝，牠的母亲因为病重无法康复而安乐死，院方将小南从牠的育儿袋抱出来，交由志工凯莉照顾饲养，小南开始不喝奶，因为进入换食阶段，需要母亲制造的软便。宾蒂造访奥勒冈海岸水族馆，除了见到海狮老友，也认识了新朋友，包括港湾海豹、白斑角鲨和北太平洋巨型章鱼。

programme.title: 赛伦盖提-非洲之心
programme.desc: 位于非洲中心的塞伦盖提是一片罕见的野地，主宰塞伦盖提的不是动物之王狮子，而是卑微的牛羚，牠们每年穿越大平原的迁徙活动，是整个生态系的核心。

programme.title: 日本野生大地第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 以超现代城市闻名的日本，由节目带来另一种风貌，纯野生动物纪录片系列带领观众踏上横跨日本列岛的旅程，从北海道辽阔的原始森林，到冲绳葱郁缤纷的海岸线，揭开日本最具代表性野生动物的秘密。

programme.title: 动物家族保卫战
programme.desc: 在动物界，繁殖与守护后代的本能凌驾于一切。每一种动物都发展出独特的策略来完成使命，展现出创意且令人惊叹的解方。

programme.title: 捕蛇专家第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 茱莉亚贝克是澳洲的捕蛇专家，当澳洲的天气转热，无毒蛇和有毒蛇纷纷出洞，爬进人们的住家，这时候就需要捕蛇专家出动捕蛇。

programme.title: 野生王朝第1季:第3集
programme.desc: 在非洲最荒凉的地方，生存是场战斗，到目前为止最困难的挑战，就是要确保下一代可以活到成年，身为母亲，牠们必须是凶猛的保护者，母狮会远离狮群生下小狮，等到小狮张开眼睛后，才会跟狮群会合，由狮群负责照顾；鳄鱼妈妈会把刚孵出来的小鳄鱼藏在草丛或芦苇丛中，在小鳄鱼最脆弱的时候，牠会逗留在附近，尽全力赶走危险；黄狒狒妈妈组成妈妈团体看顾小狒狒；疣猪实行异母哺乳，喂养彼此的小猪；花豹妈妈在小花豹两岁前都会确保孩子不会挨饿，这就是非洲荒野的母亲。

programme.desc: 罗伯特长期带科摩多龙英妲进行目标训练，两位蜥蜴科学家前来研究英妲，利用高速摄影机和测力板了解古巨蜥，人类可能是牠们灭亡的原因，答案在于速度。小南是孤儿无尾熊宝宝，牠的母亲因为病重无法康复而安乐死，院方将小南从牠的育儿袋抱出来，交由志工凯莉照顾饲养，小南开始不喝奶，因为进入换食阶段，需要母亲制造的软便。宾蒂造访奥勒冈海岸水族馆，除了见到海狮老友，也认识了新朋友，包括港湾海豹、白斑角鲨和北太平洋巨型章鱼。

programme.title: 动物父母心第1季:第5集
programme.desc: 要在丛林生活并不容易，为了扶养下一代，丛林父母必须寻找合适的家，但找到安身之处只是个开始。

programme.title: 捕蛇专家第1季:第1集
programme.desc: 茱莉亚贝克是澳洲的捕蛇专家，当澳洲的天气转热，无毒蛇和有毒蛇纷纷出洞，爬进人们的住家，这时候就需要捕蛇专家出动捕蛇。

programme.title: 日本野生大地第1季:第2集
programme.desc: 以超现代城市闻名的日本，由节目带来另一种风貌，纯野生动物纪录片系列带领观众踏上横跨日本列岛的旅程，从北海道辽阔的原始森林，到冲绳葱郁缤纷的海岸线，揭开日本最具代表性野生动物的秘密。

programme.title: 热血兽医师第4季:第12集
programme.desc: 比特斗牛犬洛基被一条响尾蛇咬伤，饲主发现之后自行处理伤口，隔天醒来赫然发现爱犬被咬伤的腿严重肿胀，伤口也开始溃烂，他们紧急送牠去找杰夫医师。

programme.title: 鳄鱼拍档这一家第2季:第12集
programme.desc: 澳洲动物园明年就要庆祝五十周年庆了。为了迎接这一天，动物园内的鳄鱼展示区正在进行重修。在修期间，原本在展示区内的短吻鳄都要被迁移到另一个大池中。这是罗伯特第一次捕捉鳄鱼。为了能顺利捕捉到所有短吻鳄，捕捉人员会分成两人一组，用食物把池里的短吻鳄都吸引出来，一次把牠们全都捕捉起来，免得有些短吻鳄看到同伴被捉，就躲到水池里，这样就更麻烦了。在第一次捕捉中，他们捉到五只短吻鳄。因为货车的后车厢只装得下四只，捕鳄大师托比便决定让其中之一坐在前座。

programme.title: 动物父母心第1季:第6集
programme.desc: 本集回顾拍摄这一系列影片的心路历程以及途中遇到的挑战，摄影团队要忍受风吹日晒，高温与暴雨，还要有十足的耐心。

programme.title: 路易斯安纳保育战第2季:第8集
programme.desc: 在波西尔堂区，弓箭猎季期间，几个年轻人违法在树林中开枪练靶。在圣伯纳德堂区，服务24年的大卫努涅兹中队长即将退休，最后的值勤日在搭档华格纳警士的作弄和认真查验渔船中度过。他把招牌码尺传给华格纳警士后，在众同僚祝福中荣退。在科德威堂区，有德州居民假冒路州居民取得便宜的居民打猎执照。在拉沙尔堂区，猎人未按规定穿猎人橘衣被开罚。一男一女乘船受困在卡塔胡拉湖，渔猎巡警出动空气推进艇也无法松动船只，只能先把人救出。在卡多堂区，干员查验民众钓鱼执照，民众迂回半天拿不出执照，反说干员没有要求查验。在杰弗孙堂区，钓客不清楚规定，钓到可保留的鱼却放回水中。在犹尼昂堂区，民众因为未支付子女抚养费被吊销打猎执照。

programme.title: 宝贝乐一通第12集
programme.desc: 在成为叛逆无礼的经典乐一通动画短片前，兔宝宝、太菲鸭和死党们都还是刚学走路的小小孩，天真无邪的好奇宝宝。 特别为学龄前儿童设计的宝贝乐一通将为卡通迷们隆重介绍这些可爱讨喜的小小明星；节目将以较小体型、甜蜜讨喜的方式呈现无比欢乐的经典卡通明星。兔宝宝、太菲鸭、傻大鸟、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充满冒险行动的维多利亚式宅第中，可是一群鬼灵精怪的小捣蛋鬼。 小兔宝宝和朋友们将邀请所有小小卡通迷，探索这个无奇不有的欢乐世界。

programme.title: 兔巴哥大工程小短片第1005集
programme.desc: 在艾克米建筑公司，兔巴哥跟萝拉兔带领一群建筑师，坦白说，他们都不应该靠近任何建筑工地，但是，他们像团队一样合作，太菲鸭、猪小弟、崔弟还有其他伙伴，用他们的工具跟工程车完成许多史上最疯狂的工程。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第67集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第73集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.title: 宝贝乐一通第13集
programme.desc: 在成为叛逆无礼的经典乐一通动画短片前，兔宝宝、太菲鸭和死党们都还是刚学走路的小小孩，天真无邪的好奇宝宝。 特别为学龄前儿童设计的宝贝乐一通将为卡通迷们隆重介绍这些可爱讨喜的小小明星；节目将以较小体型、甜蜜讨喜的方式呈现无比欢乐的经典卡通明星。兔宝宝、太菲鸭、傻大鸟、崔弟和大嘴怪在老婆婆充满冒险行动的维多利亚式宅第中，可是一群鬼灵精怪的小捣蛋鬼。 小兔宝宝和朋友们将邀请所有小小卡通迷，探索这个无奇不有的欢乐世界。

programme.title: 兔巴哥大工程小短片第1006集
programme.desc: 在艾克米建筑公司，兔巴哥跟萝拉兔带领一群建筑师，坦白说，他们都不应该靠近任何建筑工地，但是，他们像团队一样合作，太菲鸭、猪小弟、崔弟还有其他伙伴，用他们的工具跟工程车完成许多史上最疯狂的工程。

programme.title: 豆豆先生第69集
programme.desc: 在大小银幕上扮演豆豆先生的罗文亚特金(Rowan Atkinson)，这次将自己变身为卡通人物，并为这部动画亲自配音！本系列忠实呈现豆豆先生这个活在真实世界的角色，每一集中，我们不幸的豆豆先生，总要大费周章弄得灰头土脸，才能完成一件简单的小事，那包括找停车位、让邻居安静下来、换沙发或是晒晒太阳等。豆豆先生忠实的搭档泰迪和邪恶的房东卫奇太太，以及她的独眼猫史加普和豆豆先生的女朋友艾玛也同台演出。这部卡通影集已经在全球150个国家播出，曾经荣获过国际艾美奖和蒙特娄金玫瑰奖的肯定，并引起豆豆先生的热潮，改编成同名电影上映。

programme.desc: 以宝可梦大师为目标继续旅行的主角小智和搭档皮卡丘来到了新的冒险舞台“神奥地区”。随后，他们与目标成为顶级协调训练家的小光和她的波加曼邂逅，一同踏上旅程。各种各样的邂逅，了解同伴的重要，在战斗中洋溢炽热的友情，不断成长。

programme.title: 真珠美人鱼第86集
programme.desc: 北太平洋美人鱼公主露亚为找回失落的真珠来到人间，并与人类少年堂本海斗相恋的故事。 同时，她必须联合七大洋的美人鱼公主们，利用歌声的力量对抗企图征服海洋的邪恶势力，并揭开海斗隐藏的重大秘密。

programme.title: 纸箱做玩具第19集
programme.desc: 最好玩的DIY节目，赶快跟著哥哥姐姐一起来动手做玩具！ 家中一定都有不需要的纸箱，就把这些纸箱变成桌上型的迷你玩具吧！有：投篮机、扭蛋机、掌上型游戏机、好玩的对战游戏…等，亲子一起动手做、全家人一起玩游戏真是太有趣了

programme.title: 一起折气球第11集
programme.desc: 气球的造型千变万化，可以折成动物、花草、动漫人物及玩具...等，一样的技巧使用了不同的组合与应用，就能做出完全不一样的造型，本节目将带著观众一起动手做，并从中发现折气球的乐趣与奥妙，继而发挥想像力与创造力，折出独创的造型气球，专家们也将带来美不胜收的气球艺术，让观众们一起来欣赏。

programme.title: 动物大明星第2季:第5集
programme.desc: 逛完一趟动物园 爸爸：小宝，今天你认识了几种动物呢？ 小宝：好多好多喔！有大象、狮子、老虎、还有红毛猩猩... 不过为什么猴子的屁股会这么红啊？ 为什么无尾熊要睡在树上呢？ 为什么长颈鹿不坐下来休息呢？ 为什么猫头鹰的脖子可以转270度呢？为什么…为什么…为什么… 小宝的一百个疑问，谁来解答呢？ 「 动物园大明星」是专为小朋友打造的动物节目，写实记录各种动 物生态，看动物褓母怎么照顾牠们的生活起居 带小朋友进入不一样的动物世界，开启他们广阔的视野。

programme.title: MOMO欢乐谷第15季:第6集
programme.desc: 最适合小朋友观赏的优质儿童律动节目。除了好听的歌曲及好看的唱跳表演，还有哥哥和姐姐们的游戏大PK。另透过说故事的启发引导儿童们，为儿童们解答生活上和人际关系上的众多疑惑。

programme.title: 宝贝星乐园第2季:第2集

programme.title: 霸王龙雷奇第23集
programme.desc: 这是一个关于亲情、友情、勇气和爱的故事。很久很久以前，有一只特别的霸王龙，他叫雷奇。在尚未孵化的时候，雷奇就被一只雌性慈母龙捡回家，成为食草恐龙家庭的一员。身为食肉恐龙的他，有捕食者的本能，但妈妈的细心教导让他明白，不能伤害他人，所以他努力克制，成为了一只外表凶猛，但心地善良的霸王龙。在与家人、朋友、邻居们的相处中，雷奇和他的性格各异的恐龙小伙伴们相互理解、相互陪伴，体会到了亲情、友情的温暖，学会了勇敢和爱，一起快乐生活，慢慢长大。

programme.title: 泡泡孔雀鱼第63集
programme.desc: 这是一个集音乐、舞蹈、娱乐为一体的儿童动画。讲述的是一群学龄前儿童在水下城市Bubbletucky中的各种经历。透过广泛的节目主题设定，以及多元具活力及启发性的水族教室，让学龄前小朋友们和节目里茉莉、吉儿和她们的鱼同学们，在音乐和欢笑里学习科学、数学、文学，一起探索及认识世界。

programme.title: 旋风战车队第150集
programme.desc: 飙速是世界上最厉害的怪兽卡车，八岁的阿杰是他的驾驶，也是他最好的朋友。他们一起在充满怪兽卡车们的车轴市冒险。飙速有像火焰一般的爆发力，特殊的涡轮推动让他比其他怪兽卡车跑得更快，从水上飞机、滑翔翼到吹风机，飙速可以改造成任何不同的设计。阿杰借由物理原理探索、问题解决及机械组成的了解来帮助飙速完成冒险

programme.title: 玛莎与熊第39集
programme.desc: 玛莎是个充满朝气、活力四射的小女孩，住在离森林不远的小木屋里。有天意外地闯进住在森林的熊熊家，开始了充满欢笑与奇妙的生活。从马戏团退休的熊熊，在森林里度过了安稳平淡的退休生活，直到遇到了玛莎，为他的生活增添了许多乐趣，从一开始害怕玛莎的调皮捣蛋，到逐渐他们成为了最棒的朋友。在他们的生活里充满著玛莎的好奇心与熊熊对玛莎悉心的教导与照顾。 「玛莎与熊」来自于俄罗斯的3D动画，故事内容源自于俄罗斯的童话，在俄罗斯受到了大朋友与小朋友的欢迎，故事搬到现代的大萤幕中，更增添了许多冒险故事。动画中所呈现的音乐与内容都有著浓浓的俄罗斯风情，并透过立体3D的呈现方式带来了视觉与听觉上的飨宴。 「玛莎与熊」以轻

programme.desc: 气球的造型千变万化，可以折成动物、花草、动漫人物及玩具...等，一样的技巧使用了不同的组合与应用，就能做出完全不一样的造型，本节目将带著观众一起动手做，并从中发现折气球的乐趣与奥妙，继而发挥想像力与创造力，折出独创的造型气球，专家们也将带来美不胜收的气球艺术，让观众们一起来欣赏。

programme.title: 动物大明星第2季:第6集
programme.desc: 逛完一趟动物园 爸爸：小宝，今天你认识了几种动物呢？ 小宝：好多好多喔！有大象、狮子、老虎、还有红毛猩猩... 不过为什么猴子的屁股会这么红啊？ 为什么无尾熊要睡在树上呢？ 为什么长颈鹿不坐下来休息呢？ 为什么猫头鹰的脖子可以转270度呢？为什么…为什么…为什么… 小宝的一百个疑问，谁来解答呢？ 「 动物园大明星」是专为小朋友打造的动物节目，写实记录各种动 物生态，看动物褓母怎么照顾牠们的生活起居 带小朋友进入不一样的动物世界，开启他们广阔的视野。

programme.title: MOMO欢乐谷第15季:第7集

programme.title: 宝贝星乐园第2季:第3集
programme.desc: 宝贝星乐园，欢乐总动员！MOMO亲子台特地开辟一个园地，让2-12岁的小朋友可以在宝贝星乐园展现他们的才艺，秀出他们的热情大方。可以看到唱歌、舞蹈、乐器演奏等等不同小朋友的才艺，还有小朋友表演时自信投入的表现，以及家长们陪同练习在旁加油的温馨画面等等，节目气氛欢乐又热闹！除了 ​​邀请专业的评审老师给予建议讲评之外，每集也会选出最佳造型奖、最佳人气奖以及闪亮小明星奖给予鼓励，也能为小朋友们留下一个快乐的童年回忆，欢迎2 -12岁的小朋友们踊跃报名参加！

programme.title: 黏土派对第4集

programme.desc: 这是一个关于亲情、友情、勇气和爱的故事。很久很久以前，有一只特别的霸王龙，他叫雷奇。在尚未孵化的时候，雷奇就被一只雌性慈母龙捡回家，成为食草恐龙家庭的一员。身为食肉恐龙的他，有捕食者的本能，但妈妈的细心教导让他明白，不能伤害他人，所以他努力克制，成为了一只外表凶猛，但心地善良的霸王龙。在与家人、朋友、邻居们的相处中，雷奇和他的性格各异的恐龙小伙伴们相互理解、相互陪伴，体会到了亲情、友情的温暖，学会了勇敢和爱，一起快乐生活，慢慢长大。

programme.title: 旋风战车队第151集
programme.desc: 飙速是世界上最厉害的怪兽卡车，八岁的阿杰是他的驾驶，也是他最好的朋友。他们一起在充满怪兽卡车们的车轴市冒险。飙速有像火焰一般的爆发力，特殊的涡轮推动让他比其他怪兽卡车跑得更快，从水上飞机、滑翔翼到吹风机，飙速可以改造成任何不同的设计。阿杰借由物理原理探索、问题解决及机械组成的了解来帮助飙速完成冒险

programme.title: 玛莎与熊第40集
programme.desc: 玛莎是个充满朝气、活力四射的小女孩，住在离森林不远的小木屋里。有天意外地闯进住在森林的熊熊家，开始了充满欢笑与奇妙的生活。从马戏团退休的熊熊，在森林里度过了安稳平淡的退休生活，直到遇到了玛莎，为他的生活增添了许多乐趣，从一开始害怕玛莎的调皮捣蛋，到逐渐他们成为了最棒的朋友。在他们的生活里充满著玛莎的好奇心与熊熊对玛莎悉心的教导与照顾。 「玛莎与熊」来自于俄罗斯的3D动画，故事内容源自于俄罗斯的童话，在俄罗斯受到了大朋友与小朋友的欢迎，故事搬到现代的大萤幕中，更增添了许多冒险故事。动画中所呈现的音乐与内容都有著浓浓的俄罗斯风情，并透过立体3D的呈现方式带来了视觉与听觉上的飨宴。 「玛莎与熊」以轻

programme.title: 原来如此第12集

programme.title: PUIPUI天竺鼠车车第7集
programme.desc: 故事舞台发生在一个天竺鼠变成车子的世界。疗愈系的车“天竺鼠车车”。圆滚滚的眼睛和又大又圆的屁股，短短的手脚。常常一脸傻乎乎地四处奔波的天竺鼠车车。即使塞车了，只要看著前面的天竺鼠车车的屁股就能被疗愈，就算制造了一些麻烦，因为毛茸茸太可爱了也能原谅吧？！以汽车各式各样的情境为中心的疗愈、友情、冒险、乱七八糟的动作戏以及超多天竺鼠的动画！

programme.title: 盖比的娃娃屋第17集
programme.desc: 在这段节目中，你将会看到一只可爱的猫咪和它的好搭档猫熊喵一起展开一场充满活力和惊喜的冒险。他们会透过手工艺创造出无穷的变化，让你目不暇接。此外，还有令人惊叹的魔法表演，让整个节目更加多采多姿。跟著热爱猫咪的盖比一起探索这个精彩的世界吧！

programme.title: SuperWings第30集
programme.desc: 讲述了飞机机器人乐迪与一群称为“Super Wings”的小伙伴环游世界，为小朋友递送包裹，并帮助他们解决困难的故事。作品最大的特点是每一集发生的城市都不同，用精美的画面展现了世界多元文化，例如名胜、建筑、语言、节日和美食等。故事传递著善良、勇敢、欢乐和友爱，让孩子在每一次新的神奇之旅中，可以开阔眼界并认识到多彩绚丽的地球家园。

programme.title: POLI第29集
programme.desc: 在美丽的布鲁姆斯小镇，有一群救援小英雄，分别是富有正义感的警车队长-波力、勇敢又可靠消防车-罗伊、善良又聪明的救护车-安宝以及反应敏捷的直升机-赫利。为保护小镇居民的安全，英勇的救援小队将同心协力克服困难与危险帮助朋友们！跟著波力一起出发去救援吧！当朋友有需要帮助的时候，救援小队就会适时地出现，用团队合作及智慧来解决困难。小朋友能从救援小队帮助别人的行动中，学习日常生活中应该如何小心防范周遭事物，也从中学习到助人为快乐之本的道理以及和平的与他人共处的重要性，是放心让孩子收看之优质动画。

programme.title: 可爱巧虎岛第19集
programme.desc: 故事发生在一个美丽的世外桃源，我们称之为「巧虎岛」。巧虎岛上有一群天真可爱的伙伴们，热心助人的「巧虎」、爱吃章鱼烧的「桃乐比」、有公主梦的「琪琪」,以及爱踢足球「妙妙」。在巧虎岛上四处探险，每天的生活都充满了欢笑与惊喜！

programme.title: PUIPUI天竺鼠车车第8集
programme.desc: 故事舞台发生在一个天竺鼠变成车子的世界。疗愈系的车“天竺鼠车车”。圆滚滚的眼睛和又大又圆的屁股，短短的手脚。常常一脸傻乎乎地四处奔波的天竺鼠车车。即使塞车了，只要看著前面的天竺鼠车车的屁股就能被疗愈，就算制造了一些麻烦，因为毛茸茸太可爱了也能原谅吧？！以汽车各式各样的情境为中心的疗愈、友情、冒险、乱七八糟的动作戏以及超多天竺鼠的动画！

programme.title: 盖比的娃娃屋第18集
programme.desc: 在这段节目中，你将会看到一只可爱的猫咪和它的好搭档猫熊喵一起展开一场充满活力和惊喜的冒险。他们会透过手工艺创造出无穷的变化，让你目不暇接。此外，还有令人惊叹的魔法表演，让整个节目更加多采多姿。跟著热爱猫咪的盖比一起探索这个精彩的世界吧！

programme.title: SuperWings第32集
programme.desc: 讲述了飞机机器人乐迪与一群称为“Super Wings”的小伙伴环游世界，为小朋友递送包裹，并帮助他们解决困难的故事。作品最大的特点是每一集发生的城市都不同，用精美的画面展现了世界多元文化，例如名胜、建筑、语言、节日和美食等。故事传递著善良、勇敢、欢乐和友爱，让孩子在每一次新的神奇之旅中，可以开阔眼界并认识到多彩绚丽的地球家园。

programme.title: POLI第33集
programme.desc: 在美丽的布鲁姆斯小镇，有一群救援小英雄，分别是富有正义感的警车队长-波力、勇敢又可靠消防车-罗伊、善良又聪明的救护车-安宝以及反应敏捷的直升机-赫利。为保护小镇居民的安全，英勇的救援小队将同心协力克服困难与危险帮助朋友们！跟著波力一起出发去救援吧！当朋友有需要帮助的时候，救援小队就会适时地出现，用团队合作及智慧来解决困难。小朋友能从救援小队帮助别人的行动中，学习日常生活中应该如何小心防范周遭事物，也从中学习到助人为快乐之本的道理以及和平的与他人共处的重要性，是放心让孩子收看之优质动画。

programme.title: 第一战队五兽者第42集
programme.desc: 到处打工的贫穷青年远野吠于被便利店解雇后不久便遇上来自No One世界的反派组织─布莱团之侵略，然而后来吠却被特加神带走及与其签订能实现其愿望之指环契约后则获得五兽者的战队指环，而最后吠亦开始透过变身为 红狼者与布莱团对战，而同样作为五兽者的还有「前超级偶像」百夜陆王／ 蓝狮者、「特加神信奉者」暴神龙仪／ 黄暴龙者、「派对人高中生」猛原禽次郎／ 绿鹰者以及「高级名侦探」一河角乃／ 黑独角兽者。

programme.title: 蜡笔小新-大人帝国的反击第1集
programme.desc: 春日部突然举办了「20世纪博览会」，大人们都沉浸在旧时的电视节目和电影、日常生活里，小新等小孩子们感到趣味索然。当大人们从博览会回来后，每个人都开始变得懒散，不仅不再做家事、也不再到公司里去上班，每天只知沉迷在旧时的电视节目、或是玩耍里，并且开始对小孩子们视若无睹。有一天突然出现一辆电动三轮车，把所有大人载走，只留下春日部里的所有小孩。原来这一切都是一个名为「Yesterday Once More」（昨日重现）的组织所为…

programme.desc: 故事围绕著小丸子以及其家人和同学展开，有关于亲情、友谊等，或是一些生活小事，但当中有笑有泪，令人回想起童年的稚气。

programme.title: 日本女生爱台湾
programme.desc: 旅游生活实境节目，邀请日本女性分享在台湾的生活体验与文化交流。内容涵盖文化差异、生活趣事、美食推荐与旅游探索，展现日本女生眼中的台湾风情与日常故事。

programme.title: 夜市王之OH!夜市
programme.desc: 全台湾夜市多达300多个，这次要来直击你家巷口的冷门夜市！走访台湾鲜为人知的夜市。每集采不同游戏主题，PK争夺台湾「夜市王」的称号！从中发掘每处夜市的特色与差异，也让更多国外朋友认识并爱上台湾夜市文化。

programme.title: 一字千金
programme.desc: 以汉字为主题并体验中华文字之美的益智竞赛节目，号称「最紧张、最刺激的文字书写比赛」节目中所有书写字体均以正体字为依据，其标准为中华民国教育部所颁布的标准楷书，并以常用国字标准字体表、次常用国字标准字体表收录的常用汉字为范畴。至于答案的认定，则以教育部重编国语辞典修订本和各位教授之定夺为最终依据。

programme.title: 欢乐智多星
programme.desc: 每集都有不同来宾上门来挑战，展现机智还能带走高额奖金；但答错更有笑点，各种意想不到的选项和理由，让你笑到「并轨」制作团队绞尽脑汁，出题范围不设限，宛如一本不断扩充的知识百科全书。

programme.title: 包青天第112集
programme.desc: 本剧内容描述古代中国民间故事中，宋朝最家喻户晓的名臣包拯担任开封府尹期间所审理过的一些奇特刑案。

programme.title: 明日也晴朗第49集
programme.desc: 姜荷妮是为了生活不停赚钱的打工仔，为了帮忙家计，她做过百种兼职，为了生活即使让她在职场放下自尊也无妨，却因为在电视购物的一通恶作剧电话，让她失去工作，但也因此与汉杰相遇；不屈不挠的性格让荷妮勇往直前初创服饰公司，却意外听见母亲说她是捡来的孩子，面对自己失去的童年记忆，她想寻找亲生父母，却仿佛有种不明的势力在阻止著她...

programme.title: 阿叔第27集
programme.desc: 王文钦从小住在嘉义朴子，是当地唯一的「木工家具修复师」，传承老一辈的工匠精神，文钦做事认真，初恋没有开花结果的他，一生未娶，独力抚养姪子姪女。他不仅修复破损的家具，更看见历史的痕迹和故事。而他深切希望修复自己的老家，找回失落的家具，延续家族的回忆。 文钦的初恋情人纪明珠从台北回到嘉义朴子，揭开了文钦不为人知的过去与隐藏的秘密。其后两人开始重新找寻新的情感模式，修复了心中那些被时间模糊的回忆和情感。文钦用他的技艺和爱心，修复人们与自己心中的缺憾，并带来了希望与温暖
